title: CircuitryProfile
description: JSON Schema for Circuitry named profile files (profiles/<name>.yml), consumed by `cof run --profile <name>`.

adapter.description: Run-level default adapter override. Precedence: CLI > profile > orchestration > config.

model.description: Run-level default model override. Precedence: CLI > profile > orchestration > config.

inputs.description: Merged into the initial state as a base layer. CLI -e values win over profile inputs.

effects.description: Per-effect overrides, keyed by dotted effect path as it appears in state (e.g. 'summarize' or 'my_dynamic.child').

model.description: Overrides this effect's model at compile time.

provider.description: Overrides this effect's provider at compile time.

enabled.description: false = do not execute this effect for the run; its node is written as {value: null, meta: {disabled: true, ...}}. Disabling a container (dynamic/loop/conditional/reflector) disables its whole subtree.

persistence.description: Persistence backend override. Parsed/validated here; backend selection behavior is implemented by a sibling task.
